content: Is anyone already working on fixing the sorries/commented parts of ToMathlib.Rearrangement?

Yes, indeed I have been working on several of these. I have focussed on those lemmas that I needed to finish the proofs of the results on Lorentz norms and spaces and am now almost done with them (planning to open a PR soon).

For the remaining sorries/commented parts it would have to be decided if we just remove them (initially I just stole a bunch of statements about the decreasing rearrangement from another (unfinished) project without knowing precisely which ones I would need) or if some should be worked on to eventually be included in a mathlib port.
I have opened a draft PR now, in case you want to see how the file looks like at the moment: https://github.com/fpvandoorn/carleson/pull/551
